scope: One bounded Colab lifetime, one public authenticated API, one model process and one A100 80GB. Recorded before task submission; startup allocation and preflight already observed.
requirements: Owner-local condition evaluation and admission share one arbitration domain; remote acceptance rechecks its own state.
Unknown or conflicting necessary observations never authorize an effect.
Independent prepare, GPU and encode/validate work may overlap within budget.
A terminal task, artifact integrity, service cleanup and platform release require separate evidence.

selected_strategy.precision: native BF16 with upstream FP32 exceptions; no quantization
selected_strategy.submission_precondition: Observed current public API ready and current model_ready strictly false before each original submission.
selected_strategy.unknown_submission: Reconcile original persisted job identity; do not resubmit or automatically start another GPU.
selected_strategy.cleanup: After terminal observations or bounded failure, stop owned service, retain cleanup and no-GPU-process observation, then release Colab runtime and independently observe no active sessions.

evidence: Exact executed source hashes, instance/job/attempt/decision/lease identities and timestamps
Complete manager/model events plus final bounded budget ledger, with truncation explicitly checked
Authenticated public health/system queries, reference uploads and durable queue/cancellation responses
Loaded parameter precision and effective per-task generation options
Full artifact decode, media shape and downloaded SHA256
Separate service and platform release receipts
interpretation_limits: CPU counterexamples cover unknown/conflict and races without running the full GPU model.
If no unknown/conflict occurs in this normal GPU run, those branches remain not_exercised, not passed by absence.
Different fresh content cannot establish acceleration benefit or a latency distribution.
Stage/lease overlap is not CUDA kernel occupancy; no full-model physical optimum or bandwidth optimum is claimed.
This protocol is a plan; success must be recorded separately with actual observations.
